mapper.sql: id, symbol, analysis_time, trigger_type, rsi6, rsi14, daily_return, five_day_return, vix, us10y, brent, hyg_return, event_stage, reversibility, fundamental_damage, financial_stress, event_pricing, second_order_pricing, seller_exhaustion, technical_score, mean_reversion_score, action, confidence, market_is_trading, reasoning_summary, market_snapshot_json, news_json, analysis_json, status, error_message, created_at, updated_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO MARKET_STRESS_ANALYSIS (symbol, analysis_time, trigger_type, rsi6, rsi14, daily_return, five_day_return, status, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{symbol}, #{analysisTime}, #{triggerType}, #{rsi6}, #{rsi14}, #{dailyReturn}, #{fiveDayReturn}, #{status}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
mapper.select: SELECT MAX(analysis_time) FROM MARKET_STRESS_ANALYSIS WHERE UPPER(symbol) = UPPER(#{symbol}) AND status != 'FAILED'
mapper.update: UPDATE MARKET_STRESS_ANALYSIS SET rsi6 = #{rsi6}, rsi14 = #{rsi14}, daily_return = #{dailyReturn}, five_day_return = #{fiveDayReturn}, vix = #{vix}, us10y = #{us10y}, brent = #{brent}, hyg_return = #{hygReturn}, market_snapshot_json = #{marketSnapshotJson}, news_json = #{newsJson}, status = 'CONTEXT_READY', updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE MARKET_STRESS_ANALYSIS SET status = 'ANALYZING', updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}

UPDATE MARKET_STRESS_ANALYSIS SET event_stage = #{eventStage}, reversibility = #{reversibility}, fundamental_damage = #{fundamentalDamage}, financial_stress = #{financialStress}, event_pricing = #{eventPricing}, second_order_pricing = #{secondOrderPricing}, seller_exhaustion = #{sellerExhaustion}, technical_score = #{technicalScore}, mean_reversion_score = #{meanReversionScore}, action = #{action}, confidence = #{confidence}, market_is_trading = #{marketIsTrading}, reasoning_summary = #{reasoningSummary}, analysis_json = #{analysisJson}, status = 'COMPLETED', error_message = NULL, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE MARKET_STRESS_ANALYSIS SET status = 'FAILED', error_message = #{errorMessage}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
